maria: Quick Q — where can I find a per-pool heatmap that shows autoscale latency (time from desired_replicas change to observed_ready) and any spike-related saturation signals? I'm debugging eu-prod-2 jerkiness.
eli: Grafana has a dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/4a2f/autoscale-ops?var-pool=eu-prod-2 — look for the panel named 'Autoscale latency heatmap' and the 'Scale transition histogram'.
katie: For Prometheus, try this to get 95p transition time per pool:
katie: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(pool_scale_transition_bucket[5m])) by (pool)``` 
ash: Also watch pending requests + KV cache hits. If pending_requests spikes while kv_cache_hit_rate drops, you get scale churn. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/pool-backpressure?var-pool=eu-prod-2
sam: FYI steal_queue growth is a strong saturation signal. If steal_queue > 5 or grows >50% over 5m, flag it.
ash: Example Prometheus curl if you want to pull quickly:
ash: ```curl -s "https://prometheus.redwood.internal/api/v1/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.95,%20rate(pool_scale_transition_bucket[5m]))%20by%20(pool)"``` 
katie: Current alert 'PoolAutoscaleLagHigh' fires at 60s p95. For GPU pools with bursty sequences that baseline is noisy — I suggest raising to 90s for dedicated pools and adding a suppression window for known batch jobs. I'll open a PR.
maria: thanks — can we also get traces that tie specific requests to scale events? want to correlate a slow request with the scale transition.
eli: Yes — use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=inference&tags=pool:eu-prod-2. Correlate trace start time with pool_scale_event timestamps in Prometheus (pool_scale_event_timestamp or scale transition metrics).
oncall-bot: @oncall-eng-sre assigned: pino
pino: I'll take this. maria — can you give a concrete timeframe (UTC) where you saw the jitter?
maria: yesterday between 2026-03-14 15:02 and 15:12 UTC — multiple short spikes.
pino: digging in now. if you can, snapshot the three panels (autoscale heatmap, pending_requests, steal_queue) and drop links here.
maria: snapshot uploaded: https://grafana.redwood.internal/snapshot/abcd1234
ash: quick rule of thumb — kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.6 + batch_latency up usually precedes autoscale thrash. We can add a temporary suppression rule or increase kv cache prefetch for that pool.
sam: I'll file INF-4521 to adjust thresholds and create a dedicated row for eu-prod pools in the autoscale dashboard. will add proposed thresholds and a PR link.
katie: +1 on INF-4521, add me as reviewer and I'll help with alert wording and runbook steps.
maria: awesome, thanks y'all :thumbsup:
eli: small note — when you open the PR, include an example of the false-positive window (attach graphs). That speeds review.
sam: will do, aiming to have the ticket + PR draft by EOD PST.
maria: great — ping me when it's up and i'll re-run the traces.
